tree_axis_gate.relative_time_normalization: for an ultrametric retained-tip tree: pairwise patristic distance / (2 * mean root-to-tip tree height), yielding 0..1 relative divergence time
tree_axis_gate.patristic_fallback_normalization: for a non-ultrametric retained-tip tree: pairwise patristic distance / maximum retained-tip pairwise patristic distance
tree_axis_gate.no_mixed_labeling: the two normalized axes may be plotted on the same 0..1 support but must retain distinct labels and may not be pooled as literal time unless all included trees pass the relative-time gate

state_hierarchy.intermediate: WHITE / DARK / WARM / COOL perceptual families

primary_output.interpretation: positive excess means same-state sharing above the frequency-preserving random baseline at that evolutionary depth

secondary_output.near_far_contrast: same_probability in shallowest quartile minus deepest quartile
secondary_output.distance_decay_slope: OLS slope of same-state indicator on normalized axis, used descriptively with permutation inference
secondary_output.permutation_unit: jointly permute complete coarse/intermediate/fine state triplets across retained tips within clade
